verdict.rationale: Evidence shows NVIDIA touts H200 for LLM inference speedups (Llama2, GPT-3) and pairs it with NIM microservices for GenAI deployment, plus a community report of Llama 405B running on H200 SXM in production. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents FP8/FP4 precision support or names specific serving stacks like TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, or llama.cpp for this part. missing for 10: explicit FP8/FP4 precision documentation, named serving-stack support (TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, ROCm, llama.cpp) tied to H200.
